as_told.title: John Piña Craven and Navy seafloor recovery

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book called The Silent War by John P. Craven, whom he describes as a high-ranking figure in the US Navy. Michels says Craven writes about recovering exotic technology from the seafloor, which, if it means what Michels suggests, would hint at strange objects being retrieved from the ocean in secret.
